test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ADEC is related to GJKI in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, HKLJ is related to NQRP. To which of the following is MPQO related to, following the same logic?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/000b411879530837ff2b80ef30bf2acbcffe33a433f156294f778a73811707f5.png] ​

**Logic: '6' is added to the positional value of each alphabet.**

ADEC is related to GJKI →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5617ba3aa19fc107a38f5339004cc1560bde7b3bc268c48b80670a5d74049e35.png] 

HKLJ is related to NQRP →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5d8373ba2ff8a18747eeb7bf353e4f1cd408cfb341cc2b7067f425316c9571d.png] 

Similarly, MPQO will be related to:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51adc83f84305bef3ec086181974298874f052a281ad309a9e878ffc3620bde4.png] 

Here, 'MPQO' is related to **'SVWU'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
